lines.t: He step back and we step back, now we strugglin' just to hear him
Keep him in my chest, pour her in spirit
Know I need him
When he step at that pressure, his love in disguise
Make me hunger for his voice, put the thirst in my eyes
Blessed are the poor in spirit, they gon' walk through that door
King, I'm sittin' in my chest, but I still ask him for more
He said, I move backward, cause you move backward, driftin'
Closed up the table, now your trust gotta be lifted
Fed you me from my hand, pour my heart in your ear
Now I'm silent for a season, just to test if you fear it
I was leanin' on the prophet, treatin' man like the rock
He removed the lampstand, pulled the shepherd off the block
Left alone with the mirror, had the look in my soul
Had to face all the secrets, let confession take hold
Thought I knew him as he is, had him fit in my frame
But his ways above the heavens, I was playin' with his name
Church talk, big talk, but my spirit was poor
Till he stripped all my support, laid me flat on the floor
When he step at his pressure, that love in disguise
Make me hunger for his voice, put the thirst in my eyes
Blessed are they that hunger, thirst for righteousness reign
He gon' fill them with his life, make them rise from the pain
Kingdom ain't any lies, it ain't stuck in abuse
It's a fire in the temple where his spirit moves
When he quiet all the noise, you can hear that within
Still voice cut deep, call you out of your sin
He said, crucify yourself daily, lay it all on the line
Who you choose gon' define how you walk, how you grind
So I died to my image, let his word be the blade
Let him tear down every idol that my own hands made
Pouring spirit, I'm empty, that's the place he would feel
When I'm broken and I'm honest, he revealing his will
Now I'm searching for his kingdom, not the fame, not the clout
Just that wellspring of Yahushua that can never run out
When he step at his pressure, that love in disguise
Make me hunger for his voice, put the thirst in my eyes
He first his kingdom and you, seek his righteousness first
He gon' meet you in that desert, quench the deepest thirst
So if he step back from your life, don't run to the crowd
Falling to him unreserved, cry his name out loud
Cause the ones that know they need him, he gon' raise them up high
And the proud that think they know him, they gon' break when he's dry
